quickInfo.name: Hang Five skill shot
quickInfo.summary: Plunge into the top Hang Five saucer for 100 points and an upper-flipper feed.

quickInfo.name: Blue bumpers
quickInfo.summary: Hits on the blue mushroom bumpers raise the Ring-a-Ding saucer value.

quickInfo.name: Red bumper
quickInfo.summary: A hit on the red mushroom bumper closes the lower zipper flippers.

quickInfo.name: Yellow bumpers
quickInfo.summary: A hit on either yellow mushroom bumper reopens the zipper flippers.

quickInfo.name: Ring-a-Ding route
quickInfo.summary: The right loop feeds the Ring-a-Ding saucer, which is the repeatable scoring shot at 300.

steps.text: Plunge for the top Hang Five saucer.
Use the upper flipper to graze a blue bumper while the Ring-a-Ding value is below 300.
Stop blue-bumper hits when the Ring-a-Ding value reaches 300.
Hit the red mushroom bumper to close the lower flippers.
Use a legal nudge to settle the ball on the closed flippers.
Shoot through the right loop into the Ring-a-Ding saucer.
Flip the saucer eject directly back into the saucer when the feed permits it.
Otherwise, settle the ball on the closed flippers and repeat the right-loop shot.

fallback.title: Recovery: Right-flipper backhand
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this plan when the two-flipper right-loop shot is not reliable.

steps.text: Close the zipper flippers with the red bumper.
Use small flips to move the settled ball onto the right flipper.
Backhand the Ring-a-Ding saucer from the right flipper.
Repeat the backhand while the saucer eject remains controlled.

alternatives.title: Position play: Hang Five repeat
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this distinct scoreboard route: use this plan when the Hang Five eject returns cleanly to the upper flipper.

steps.text: Plunge or feed the ball into the Hang Five saucer.
Read the eject before the ball reaches the upper flipper.
Flip the ball directly back into Hang Five.
Stop the repeat when the eject no longer reaches the upper flipper cleanly.
Hit the blue bumpers until the Ring-a-Ding saucer value reaches 300.
Close the zipper flippers with the red bumper.
Settle the ball on the closed flippers.
Repeat the Ring-a-Ding saucer through the right loop.

playfieldReferences.label: Ring-a-Ding saucer
playfieldReferences.description: Saucer reached through the right loop for the main repeat scoring route.
playfieldReferences.context: Raise the saucer value, close the zipper flippers, then repeat the right loop.

techniques.name: Two-flipper loop shot
techniques.instruction: Flip both lower flippers almost together. Start the left flipper slightly earlier if a simultaneous flip misses the right loop.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Use small flips on the closed flippers. Move the ball onto the right flipper before the saucer backhand.

techniques.name: Bumper edge graze
techniques.instruction: Contact the edge of a needed bumper. Avoid a direct hit that can send the ball toward a drain.

cautions.issue: A yellow-bumper hit reopens the zipper flippers.
cautions.response: Avoid the yellow bumpers after the red bumper closes the flippers. Prepare both flippers if a yellow hit occurs.

cautions.issue: A direct bumper hit can create an uncontrolled rebound.
cautions.response: Graze only the needed bumper edge. Stop blue-bumper shots when the saucer reaches 300.

cautions.issue: The right outlane gate opens only after its white rollover is lit and scored.
cautions.response: Read the gate before you depend on it. Treat an unconfirmed gate as closed.

input.simpleOverview: Surfers uses blue-bumper hits to raise the Ring-a-Ding saucer and the red bumper to close the zipper flippers. Bring the saucer to 300, close the flippers, settle the ball, and repeat the right loop into Ring-a-Ding.
input.overview: Surfers uses blue-bumper hits to raise the Ring-a-Ding saucer and the red bumper to close the zipper flippers. Use the Hang Five plunge for upper play, raise Ring-a-Ding to 300 with blue-bumper hits, then close and settle the flippers before repeating the right loop. Reclose the flippers whenever a yellow-bumper hit opens them.
